codeReview.summary: The fix commit is narrowly scoped to `.gitignore`, but it does not remediate the two original blocking findings from `replace-root-biome-with-oxlint-oxfmt-config` (out-of-scope mission/orchestration churn and unrelated app/package source churn in commit `d79c6ddabf0550c0c83ac553dc0ccaf8b7782e17`).

issues.description: Fix commit `c5e2a92337266fbafe240890a7565510f71cc1a7` only adds ignore patterns for local artifact paths (`.serena/`, `_bmad/`, `.claude/commands/`, `.cursor/commands/`) and does not remove or isolate the already-committed out-of-scope mission/orchestration files that triggered the prior blocking scrutiny failure.

Prior blocking issue for unrelated app/package churn remains unaddressed: original commit `d79c6ddabf0550c0c83ac553dc0ccaf8b7782e17` still includes broad non-root-tooling edits across app/package sources (55 files changed total), and the fix commit does not revert or isolate that churn.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Fix execution appears to optimize for validator cleanliness rather than explicitly closing prior scrutiny blockers; the worker handoff claims scope-cleanup success while evidence shows only ignore-rule additions.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Fix handoff `whatWasImplemented` states only `.gitignore` ignore-path additions; no revert/isolation actions for files from prior failed commit `d79c6dd...` are present in the diff (`git show --stat c5e2a923...` => 1 file changed).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Feature metadata for the fix is filed under milestone `workspace-command-surface` while this rerun is being used to address failures in milestone `root-oxlint-oxfmt-ultracite`, which can confuse scrutiny traceability.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `features.json` lists `scope-cleanup-root-oxlint-migration` at `milestone: workspace-command-surface` (line ~311) while prior failure and review artifacts live under `.factory/validation/root-oxlint-oxfmt-ultracite/`.

summary: Fail: the rerun fix is cleanly scoped but does not actually resolve the original two blocking scrutiny findings; it only adds ignore entries for local artifacts and leaves prior out-of-scope and unrelated churn findings unresolved.
